listen_address.description: IP address to bind the kxd API server to.

listen_port.description: Port to listen on for the kxd API server.

paths_work_dir.description: Directory for temporary job working files (e.g., compiled binaries).

paths_state_dir.description: Directory for persistent state (e.g., job metadata, caches).

limits_max_memory_mb.description: Maximum memory (in MiB) allowed per sandboxed job.

limits_max_cpu_time_sec.description: Maximum CPU time (in seconds) allowed per sandboxed job before termination.

limits_max_open_files.description: Maximum number of open file descriptors allowed per sandboxed job.

limits_max_processes.description: Maximum number of processes allowed per sandboxed job.

workers_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn.

workers_gc_interval_sec.description: Interval (in seconds) between worker garbage collection cycles.

security_allow_network.description: Allow sandboxed jobs to access the network. Disable for stricter isolation.

security_sandbox_fs.description: Enable filesystem sandboxing using mount namespaces or chroot.

security_allowed_images.description: List of allowed base images for sandboxed jobs. Each entry defines a name, filesystem path, and whether the image is mounted read-only.

name.description: Friendly identifier for the image (used in job specs).

path.description: Absolute path to the image archive or rootfs directory.

read_only.description: Mount the image read-only. Set to false only for development/debugging.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level. Choose from: debug, info, warn, error.
